ValidationRule.description: Gitlab #26422- This validation rules can be used for Closed Cases
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Global_Service_Case', ISCHANGED(ContactId), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Resolved'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Customer Unresponsive')), NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISCHANGED(Status)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can not change the contact once the case is Resolved or Customer Unresponsive.
